units.rawText: It would be bad if I actually got infected by the Entropy. In any case, let's find out where the source is first.

spans.text: It would be bad if I actually got infected by the Entropy. In any case, let's find out where the source is first.

units.rawText: My guess is it's probably really hard to find by normal means, otherwise Riko would have detected it by now... Fortunately, we have you, little buddy.

units.displayText: ...Holy crap, that many?

units.rawText: If I'd begun fighting carelessly, I'd most likely have gotten infected... That was close.
units.displayText: If I'd begun fighting carelessly, I'd most likely have gotten infected... That was close.

spans.text: If I'd begun fighting carelessly, I'd most likely have gotten infected... That was close.

units.rawText: Professor! We can't keep Faith occupied for much longer, some of our agents have suffered injuries already...
units.displayText: Professor! We can't keep Faith occupied for much longer, some of our agents have suffered injuries already...

spans.text: Professor! We can't keep Faith occupied for much longer, some of our agents have suffered injuries already...

units.rawText: Thank you, you've bought far more time than expected.
units.displayText: Thank you, you've bought far more time than expected.

spans.text: Thank you, you've bought far more time than expected.

units.rawText: After this, split up and deactivate your Spoof Codes before withdrawing to the Oasis.

units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

spans.text: Faith should notice something's wrong soon and come back here... I need to hurry.

spans.text: I wave to the diminutive Entropic and it hops back onto my shoulder.

units.rawText: After hiding in a compartment that the diminutive Entropic has given the all-clear, I activate the program to fake my Entropization. Now, in the Sanctifiers' eyes, I will be the Entropized "Irregular Agent".
units.displayText: After hiding in a compartment that the diminutive Entropic has given the all-clear, I activate the program to fake my Entropization. Now, in the Sanctifiers' eyes, I will be the Entropized "Irregular Agent".

spans.text: After hiding in a compartment that the diminutive Entropic has given the all-clear, I activate the program to fake my Entropization. Now, in the Sanctifiers' eyes, I will be the Entropized "Irregular Agent".

units.rawText: ...Once they find me here, the Sanctifiers will probably realize something's wrong with the cargo. That way, I can use them to help me cleanse the Seed of Entropization here.

units.rawText: Also, since the "Irregular Agent" is here, the Sanctifiers will abandon their pursuit of Mayuri, which means she and Riko will be safer.
